changeSet.author: oe

preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from clinlims.site_information where name = 'overrideDefaultTranslation';

changeSet.comment: Add overrideDefaultTranslation to site_information (Site Information), so an implementation can switch deployment-supplied translations on from the UI rather than only from SystemConfiguration.properties. Sits in siteIdentity beside allowLanguageChange and the default language locale. The description column caps at 120 characters, so the fuller wording lives under siteInfo.overrideDefaultTranslation in the message bundles. Defaults to false, which is the shipped behaviour: the UI uses its bundled messages and does not request the mounted files at all.

column.name: description
column.value: Override the bundled UI translations with the files mounted at /translation. Each file replaces only the ids it names.
